meta.title: LSA-Probe · Evidence-first membership auditing
meta.description: Evidence-first research page for LSA-Probe, a white-box membership audit for music diffusion models.
a11y.audit_flow: Candidate audio is evaluated through an audited diffusion model to produce a membership audit score
a11y.stability_alt: Conceptual curves where the member reaches the same degradation threshold at a larger perturbation budget
a11y.framework_alt: LSA-Probe framework showing forward diffusion, time-normalized perturbation, inner PGD, outer bisection and membership decision
hero.venue: ICASSP 2026 · Oral · Information Forensics and Security
hero.paper_title: Membership Inference Attack Against Music Diffusion Models via Generative Manifold Perturbation
hero.deck: We replace a noisy endpoint signal with a behavioral stability score: the minimum time-normalized latent perturbation required to cross a fixed perceptual degradation threshold.
hero.ledger_note: Aggregate results, not a claim about every sample.
audit.title: What are we auditing?
audit.intro: Given a candidate audio clip and an audited music diffusion model, estimate whether the clip was used during training.
audit.flow_question: Was this clip used during training?
audit.member_body: The clip belongs to the target model’s training set.
audit.nonmember_body: The clip was not included in the target model’s training set.
audit.boundary: Membership inference produces a statistical audit signal. It is not training-data extraction, model inversion, attribute inference, or standalone legal proof of copyright infringement.
threat.title: A strong, explicit white-box threat model
threat.intro: LSA-Probe is designed for a developer or authorised auditor who can inspect and differentiate through the model’s reverse process.
threat.point1: Can run forward diffusion and deterministic reverse sampling.
threat.point2: Can compute gradients with respect to an intermediate diffusion state.
threat.point3: Does not need shadow models or member labels from the target model.
threat.point4: Does need an independent non-member development set for calibration.
threat.boundary: LSA-Probe is best understood as an authorised internal audit method, not a remote black-box attack available to an ordinary user.
endpoint.title: Why endpoint reconstruction error is insufficient
endpoint.intro: A single reconstruction loss is a noisy endpoint observation, especially in the strict low-FPR regime that matters for high-cost audits.
endpoint.factor1_body: Reconstruction error changes with the diffusion state.
endpoint.factor2_body: Injected noise and sampling choices alter the endpoint.
endpoint.factor3_body: Timbre and musical complexity can confound raw loss.
endpoint.factor4_body: Waveform MSE need not track what listeners perceive.
endpoint.conclusion: Instead of asking whether one reconstruction has a small error, LSA-Probe asks how much worst-case, time-normalized intervention is required to destabilise the local reverse process.
insight.title: Measure the intervention required to break local stability
insight.body: Training members empirically occupy more stable local regions of the learned reverse mapping. They require a larger bounded perturbation to reach the same perceptual degradation target.
insight.caption: Conceptual schematic — not measured sample data
insight.score_body: Minimum perturbation budget that reaches the fixed perceptual degradation target.
insight.caution: This is an empirical local-geometric interpretation, not an analytic recovery of a data manifold or a universal claim about diffusion models.
threshold.title: Two thresholds, two different jobs
threshold.tau_body: Defines the degradation target. It is calibrated as P95 on an independent non-member development set at ηref=0.05. It is not the membership cutoff.
threshold.score_body: Measures the minimum time-normalized budget required to reach τ for each candidate.
threshold.decision_body: A separate cutoff on Cadv defines the operating point, such as FPR=1%, and yields TPR@1% FPR.
method.title: Inner PGD finds direction; outer bisection finds cost
method.intro: The method searches for a strong local degradation direction at each budget, then finds the smallest successful budget.
method.framework_caption: Author-provided expanded framework, checked against Figure 1 in the paper. Image pixels are unchanged.
method.step1: Forward diffuse the candidate to an intermediate state.
method.step3: Use inner PGD to find the strongest degradation direction.
method.step4: Use outer bisection to find the minimum successful budget.
method.normalisation: The raw scale of an intervention is not comparable across diffusion timesteps because the forward noise variance changes with t. Scaling δ̃ by σt places the perturbation on the timestep’s natural noise scale.
walkthrough.kicker: Algorithm walkthrough · Illustrative control flow · Not a measured sample
walkthrough.title: Watch the two loops coordinate
walkthrough.ready: Ready. Start with the full admissible interval.
walkthrough.state2: Run the inner PGD search within the current budget.
walkthrough.state3: Compare the strongest perceptual degradation with τ.
walkthrough.state4: Update one side of the bisection interval.
walkthrough.state5: Repeat until the interval is tight; report Cadv≈u.
evidence.title: Evidence at the strict low-FPR operating point
evidence.intro: All values below are transcribed from Table 1. No per-sample distributions or ROC points are reconstructed.
evidence.missed: Members still missed at the best strict operating point
evidence.interpret_title: What the result does—and does not—show
evidence.interpret: LSA-Probe consistently improves the strict low-FPR operating point, but the best TPR at 1% FPR is 20%. The method therefore provides a stronger audit signal without solving membership auditing outright. Precision still depends on the real member base rate.

reliability.title: How the evidence was controlled
reliability.intro: The evaluation spans waveform and latent diffusion, two music domains, leakage controls, uncertainty estimates and compute-matched baselines.
reliability.setup: Deterministic DDIM · t_ratio=0.6 · p=2 · ηmax=0.8 · CDPAM · 22.05 kHz training audio · in-graph resampling to 16 kHz for metrics.
reliability.split: Piece/artist splits for MAESTRO; track/artist splits for FMA; Chromaprint + LSH duplicate and cover checks with manual review.
reliability.stats: DeLong AUC intervals; sample-level bootstrap elsewhere; 10,000 resamples; Holm–Bonferroni correction.
reliability.compute: B=10 outer × K=12 inner, roughly (K+2)B reverse passes per sample; baselines matched within ±5% wall-clock on an A100-80GB.
limitations.title: Limitations and open questions
limitations.item1: Strong white-box access is required: parameters, sampler, intermediate states and gradients.
limitations.item2: Repeated PGD, restarts and bisection make the audit computationally expensive.
limitations.item3: The best TPR@1% FPR is still only 20%.
limitations.item4: Evaluation covers two model families and two music datasets.
limitations.item5: Threshold calibration depends on an independent non-member development set.
limitations.item6: Cross-model and cross-domain threshold transfer remain underexplored.
limitations.item7: Results do not directly generalise to text LLMs or multimodal agents.
limitations.item8: A membership score is not standalone legal evidence.
limitations.item9: “Generative manifold” is an empirical local-geometric description, not an analytically recovered manifold.
limitations.item10: Defences need further study: differential privacy, regularisation, deduplication, audit-aware training and reduced memorisation.
agent.title: From Generative-Model Auditing to Agent Safety
agent.subtitle: A methodological transfer, not an experimental result of LSA-Probe.
agent.agent1: Define protected user data, memory, retrieved content and tool permissions
agent.agent2: Build authorised internal red-team and audit infrastructure
agent.lsa3: Measure the minimum intervention needed to destabilise a trajectory
agent.agent3: Measure the minimum bounded intervention needed to change a decision or tool action
agent.lsa4: Evaluate at strict low-FPR operating points
agent.agent4: Control false alarms before blocking legitimate tasks or users
agent.agent5: Preserve audit trails and uncertainty rather than issuing absolute claims
agent.transfers: Asset definition, authorised access, bounded intervention, strict operating points and uncertainty-aware audit trails.
agent.not_body: Audio latents are not LLM hidden states; diffusion trajectories are not agent plans. LSA-Probe does not detect prompt injection, stop jailbreaks, solve tool authorisation, provide trusted execution or establish effectiveness for mobile agents.
agent.direction: Generalise stability-based auditing from generative trajectories to agent decision trajectories: measure the minimum bounded intervention required to trigger an unsafe decision while jointly tracking task utility and side effects.
